# TGA Manangement Consultancy LLC

> TGA is a Dubai-based consultancy providing UAE business setup, PRO, accounting, tax, transfer pricing, audit assistance and AML compliance support.

The official website is https://www.tga-uae.com/. The company is based at Office 105, Al Jawhara Building, Mankhool, Dubai, UAE. Service descriptions are general information; contact TGA for advice about a specific matter. The company name is presented here as supplied by TGA.

## Company information

- [Website overview](https://www.tga-uae.com/index.md): Plain-language summary of services, team and contact details.
- [About TGA](https://www.tga-uae.com/about.md): Company overview, services, mission and vision.
- [Why TGA](https://www.tga-uae.com/why-tga.md): How TGA works with clients.
- [Our Team](https://www.tga-uae.com/our-team.md): Ten team members across leadership, tax, accounting, business setup and digital marketing.
- [Kintu Gandhi profile](https://www.tga-uae.com/kintu-gandhi.md): Managing Partner, qualifications and areas of experience.
- [Contact TGA](https://www.tga-uae.com/contact.md): Dubai office, telephone, WhatsApp and email details.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.tga-uae.com/faq.md): Practical answers about starting work with TGA and its service areas.
- [TGA branding](https://www.tga-uae.com/brand.md): Purpose, visual identity, colours and brand use.
- [Media Kit](https://www.tga-uae.com/media-kit.md): Web-ready logos, team collage and download package.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.tga-uae.com/privacy.md): Information handling for website visitors and enquiries.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.tga-uae.com/terms.md): Terms for using the public website and media assets.
- [Services directory](https://www.tga-uae.com/services.md): Seven grouped service areas and dedicated bank account and will registration assistance pages, including VAT and Corporate Tax filing support.
- [Company profile data](https://www.tga-uae.com/business.json): Read-only JSON record of the same public information.
- [OpenAPI description](https://www.tga-uae.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable description of the company profile JSON resource.

## Service details

- [Visa & Immigration Assistance](https://www.tga-uae.com/visa-immigration.md): Practical application and document coordination for residence, family and visit matters.
- [Labour & MOHRE Transactions](https://www.tga-uae.com/labour-mohre.md): Employer paperwork and follow-up support for work permits, contracts and labour administration.
- [Document Clearing, Attestation & Translation](https://www.tga-uae.com/document-clearing.md): Coordinate official documents, attestation, translation and notary steps through the appropriate providers.
- [Police Clearance Certificate Assistance](https://www.tga-uae.com/police-clearance.md): Application and document coordination for a UAE police clearance certificate request.
- [POA Registration Assistance](https://www.tga-uae.com/poa-registration-assistance.md): Administrative coordination with appropriate legal and notary providers.

- [Bank account opening assistance](https://www.tga-uae.com/bank-account-opening-assistance.md): Application and document coordination.
- [Will registration assistance](https://www.tga-uae.com/will-registration-assistance.md): Administrative coordination with legal advice from a qualified specialist.
- [UAE business setup](https://www.tga-uae.com/business-setup.md): Business structure and company formation support.
- [PRO services](https://www.tga-uae.com/pro-services.md): Administrative coordination, Golden Visa and liquidation support.
- [Accounting, bookkeeping and audit support](https://www.tga-uae.com/accounting-bookkeeping-audit.md): Financial records, reporting, audit assistance and IFRS impact work.
- [UAE tax, VAT and transfer pricing](https://www.tga-uae.com/tax-advisory-transfer-pricing.md): Registration, VAT and Corporate Tax filing, tax advice and transfer pricing studies.
- [AML compliance assistance](https://www.tga-uae.com/aml-compliance.md): goAML, KYC, UBO, risk controls, screening, monitoring and reporting support.
- [goAML registration support](https://www.tga-uae.com/goaml-registration-support.md): Prepare entity details and authorised access for the reporting portal.
- [Client KYC and due diligence support](https://www.tga-uae.com/client-kyc-due-diligence.md): Organise customer identification, verification and risk-based reviews.
- [UBO support](https://www.tga-uae.com/ubo-support.md): Map beneficial ownership and maintain relevant records.
- [AML risk assessments and policies](https://www.tga-uae.com/aml-risk-assessments-policies.md): Connect business risks to proportionate policies and controls.
- [Sanctions and PEP screening support](https://www.tga-uae.com/sanctions-pep-screening.md): Review screening procedures, potential matches and escalation.
- [Ongoing monitoring and records](https://www.tga-uae.com/ongoing-monitoring-records.md): Structure periodic client reviews, activity checks and records.
- [STR and SAR reporting support](https://www.tga-uae.com/str-sar-reporting-support.md): Support the responsible officer with report preparation and workflow.
- [AML training and review readiness](https://www.tga-uae.com/aml-training-review-readiness.md): Prepare staff training and evidence for compliance reviews.
